computability_complexity_boundary.rational_wfa_relation: Rational recurrence is a specific algebraic subclass connected to weighted finite-state automata; finite-automaton realizability alone does not classify the entire connected recurrent composition as rational.
computability_complexity_boundary.transcendental_rnn_claim: No standard theorem class named transcendental RNN follows merely from topology, a left-inverse representation law, or use of a Tsallis q-log/q-algebra. Those ingredients can change the representation or transition algebra, but computability depends on the precise state domain, arithmetic model, allowed constants/functions, precision, and interaction/time convention.
computability_complexity_boundary.unbounded_model_boundary: The current Agda surface proves an unbounded Nat-indexed exact clock witness and strict separation from the repository's Fin 256 recurrent baseline. It does not prove Turing completeness, super-Turing power, a named complexity class, or an upper bound for the entire connected composition.
computability_complexity_boundary.complexity_gate: A named computational-complexity result requires an explicit machine/decision/transduction problem, cost model, input encoding, arithmetic representation, and resource bound. An untruncated recurrent horizon by itself is not a complexity class.
computability_complexity_boundary.q_log_boundary: The q-log/Tsallis component is a semantic operation in the current learner state. No repository theorem currently derives a complexity-class change from it.
computability_complexity_boundary.topology_boundary: Left-invertibility and topology/conjugacy support exact information transport and state-representation equivalence; they do not by themselves establish extra computational power.
computability_complexity_boundary.optimizer_regret_boundary: Jensen/minimax regret plus rounding bias plus KKT residual plus stationary Markov mixing is represented conditionally as R ≤ J + B + K + M; no unconditional numeric regret rate is claimed.
computability_complexity_boundary.optimizer_regret_boundary_lion: Lion is represented conditionally by an explicit descent/stationarity residual L, giving R ≤ J + B + K + L + M. Literature-backed Lion rates are not imported as Agda facts; the concrete update, assumptions, and analytic proof remain promotion obligations.
computability_complexity_boundary.f4_frank_wolfe: F4 remains finite/exact; Frank-Wolfe is represented by a supplied gap/descent/KKT certificate. No optimization library is added. The eventual connected regret extension is R ≤ J + B + K + L + W + M only after shared-state composition.
computability_complexity_boundary.maxwell_scope: The physics graph is deliberately restricted to Maxwell-admissible finite encodings. Exact finite representation is a computability claim about finite functions, not a claim that finite GRUs solve the continuous Maxwell PDEs without discretization/semantics.

complete_graph_contract_v7.future_entry: Every future theorem, candidate, topology result, neighborhood result, conjugacy result, or optimizer-specific descent result must name a real composed Agda parent and be discoverable by theorem_graph_search plus theorem_monolith_egraph_sync.
complete_graph_contract_v7.promotion_order: foundational theorem -> smallest existing composed consumer -> full connected learner -> F_full_connected
complete_graph_contract_v7.disconnected_pruning: No-dependency theorems are removed from the strict separation graph as independent nodes. Their proof records remain available only when required by a consuming composed theorem; otherwise they are classified foundational and not graph-promoted.
complete_graph_contract_v7.strict_invariant: Only F_base -> full connected composition -> F_full_connected participates in strict function-class separation.
complete_graph_contract_v7.upgrade_gate: SEPARATED requires explicit resource-preserving inclusion, a connected witness, and canonical baseline nonrepresentability.
complete_graph_contract_v7.novel_candidate_rule: New exotic candidates are pre-graphed only when they have an explicit parent/path and literature-motivated algebraic shape; candidate status never substitutes for an Agda proposition or proof.

complete_graph_contract_v7.maxwell: Every future physics theorem must explicitly declare Maxwell-only scope, finite encoding, and exact representation/conjugacy; no extra physical law is admitted implicitly.
